correctness.rationale: The vacancy is a finite irreducible nearest-neighbor chain with clockwise rates q a_{i+1} and counterclockwise rates p a_{i-1}. A complete enumeration of the L rooted trees for every root gives tau_i=A a_i sum_k p^k q^(L-1-k)/(a_{i+k}a_{i+k+1}); their sum is A H. The cycle-flux identity gives J=(p^L-q^L)/H with no missing factors. Bernstein-basis independence proves the iff palindrome across the full interval, and explicit four-term algebra proves Delta factorization and signed even response. Tested against independently constructed exact generators for L=3..7: 239 exact rational/symbolic assertions in checker.py. This establishes only the stated stationary finite-volume result, not an infinite system.

originality.rationale: The stationary periodic-walk drift itself is classical (Derrida 1983) and is not claimed as new. The 2025 exclusion source establishes nonuniform-bond disorder as a source of asymmetry and a geometric inversion sufficient condition; it does not give a coefficient-palindrome if-and-only-if criterion for the high-density one-vacancy sector, the fully factorized four-site exact all-bias exceptional surface, or the no-rectification classification at length three. The four-distinct-rate cancellation (1,2,4,3) is an all-order nongeometric exception to an explicitly stated conjectural generic quadratic-response expectation. An accessible prior four-site/two-particle claim treats a different occupancy sector with quartic lifting rather than permanent all-bias symmetry. The contrast is substantive but unindexed earlier general stationary-transport analysis remains a priority risk.

value.rationale: Bias rectification of quenched-trap exclusion currents is an explicit motivation of arXiv:2512.03316, which gives only geometric sufficiency and a conjectural generic quadratic even term. The new global single-vacancy criterion identifies exactly when that effect vanishes, proves the minimum ring size for emergence, and isolates an all-distinct non-reflection-symmetric rate profile with complete all-bias cancellation. Unlike a tiny parameter recomputation, the factorized exceptional manifold and exact sign on its complement classify an entire natural sector, provide a counterexample to genericity without inversion, and separate high-density from the already-studied half-filled case.
